name: LiveKit
tagline: Open-source framework and cloud for realtime voice, video, and physical AI agents.
description: LiveKit is the realtime infrastructure layer most voice-AI stacks are built on. Its open-source Agents framework wires together streaming speech-to-text, an LLM, and text-to-speech with reliable turn detection, interruption handling, and telephony, so agents can join a session and converse in near real time. You bring your own STT, LLM, and TTS providers; LiveKit handles the low-latency WebRTC transport. It runs self-hosted under Apache 2.0 or as a managed cloud platform.
insight: OpenAI runs ChatGPT Advanced Voice on LiveKit, which reached a $1B valuation in a Jan 2026 Series C led by Index Ventures.

modelSupport.notes: BYO STT, LLM, and TTS — plug in Deepgram/Whisper, Claude/GPT/Gemini, Cartesia/ElevenLabs, etc.

edge: The open-source realtime layer most voice-agent stacks run on — sub-second STT-LLM-TTS with turn detection, interruptions, and telephony, BYO models.
pros: Powers ChatGPT Advanced Voice in production
Managed cloud option alongside the OSS
cons: Developer infrastructure, not a no-code product
You assemble and pay for STT/LLM/TTS separately
Realtime media ops add operational complexity

references.title: Voice AI engine and OpenAI partner LiveKit hits $1B valuation
